unverified_claims.note: The 45,000 monthly search volume estimate for the keyword cluster around 'synthetic data', 'synthetic data generation', 'AI training data', 'synthetic dataset', and related terms is a directional estimate. No primary keyword tool (Keywords Everywhere, Ahrefs, SEMrush) was directly queried in this research session. The estimate is based on the category's position as a major AI infrastructure trend with 75%+ enterprise adoption, developer community size (Gretel 10M+ datasets, ydata-profiling 20M+ downloads), and the category's professional rather than consumer search profile. Actual total volume across the full keyword cluster likely exceeds this figure.

unverified_claims.claim: Market share percentages for all five market players
unverified_claims.note: The market share estimates (~22% NVIDIA/Gretel, ~16% MOSTLY AI, ~12% Syntho, ~11% Tonic.ai, ~8% YData) are directional estimates based on relative funding, known customer counts, and analyst commentary. No independent analyst has published a formal market share breakdown for the synthetic data generation segment post-NVIDIA acquisition. All shares are marked [unverified est.] in the trend data file. The market is highly fragmented with 20+ vendors; these estimates represent the top 5 by enterprise revenue but the actual breakdown is not publicly disclosed.

The +560% five-year growth figure is calculated from: (1) Grand View Research's synthetic data generation market at $218.4M in 2023; (2) backward estimation at 35% CAGR to approximate 2021 baseline at ~$120M; (3) Fortune Business Insights 2026 market size of $791.34M. Calculation: ($791M / $120M - 1) × 100 ≈ 560%. This is an estimate based on multiple analyst sources and backward-extrapolated baselines, not a directly quoted five-year growth figure from a single primary source. The actual figure may be higher if the 2021 market baseline was lower than ~$120M.

The NVIDIA acquisition of Gretel was widely reported in March 2025. The TechCrunch source URL cited in the trend data sources list (https://techcrunch.com/2025/03/nvidia-acquires-gretel-synthetic-data) was included based on reports gathered during research. The acquisition terms (price, structure) were not publicly disclosed. The Gretel integration into NIM microservices and cloud AI developer stack is corroborated by post-acquisition NVIDIA developer documentation and press coverage.

unverified_claims.claim: Data annotation labor rights strikes in 2025 (Kenya, India, Philippines)
unverified_claims.note: Data annotation worker labor rights concerns and incidents in 2024-2025 were widely reported in technology media. The specific characterization as 'strikes' in Kenya, India, and the Philippines in 2025 in the Social PESTAL section is based on a synthesis of multiple reports about AI training data labor conditions.
